assays.assay_description: Horizontal activity (ambulation counts via 16 infrared photobeams) measured in Digiscan chambers (40.5 x 40.5 x 30.5 cm) for 8 h in 10-min bins following acute i.p. injection of vehicle, DOM, 4-OH-MiPT, 5-MeO-DBT, or 5-Cl-DMT.

application_type.evidence: All compounds were administered intraperitoneally in a volume of ... 10 mL/kg in mice.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were injected immediately prior to locomotor activity testing; no separate apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice freely moved in the Digiscan locomotor activity testing chambers (40.5 x 40.5 x 30.5 cm).

food_restriction.evidence: Mice allowed free access to food and water in home cages; no food in activity chambers during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Mice allowed free access to water in home cages; no water in activity chambers during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Separate groups of 8 mice were injected ... immediately prior to locomotor activity testing.

sample_size.evidence: Male Swiss Webster mice (n = 248) ... Separate groups of 8 mice were injected ... n = 8 for each dose.

outcomes.summary: DOM, 4-OH-MiPT, 5-MeO-DBT, and 5-Cl-DMT all produced dose- and time-dependent depression of locomotor activity. DOM ED50=4.8 mg/kg, 4-OH-MiPT ED50=5.8 mg/kg (also a ~50-min stimulant phase), 5-MeO-DBT ID50=16.5 mg/kg with apparent late stimulant phase n.s. vs vehicle, 5-Cl-DMT ID50=12.3 mg/kg.
outcomes.evidence: Treatment with DOM ... resulted in time- and dose-dependent depression of locomotor activity ... 4-OH-MiPT ... produced time- and dose-dependent depression ... 5-MeO-DBT ... produced depression ... 5-Cl-DMT ... resulted in depression of locomotor activity.

assays.assay_description: Two-lever operant discrimination: rats trained to discriminate DOM (0.5 mg/kg, 30-min pretreatment) from saline on an FR10 food-reinforced schedule. Substitution tests (max 20 min) measured %DOM-lever responding and response rate following 4-OH-MiPT, 5-MeO-DBT (30-min pretreatment), or 5-Cl-DMT (15-min pretreatment).

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneal (i.p.) injections (1 mL/kg) of vehicle or test compound were administered

setup_habituation.evidence: The rats received approximately 60 of these sessions before they were used in tests for the substitution of the experimental compounds.

setup_restrain.evidence: Standard operant behavior-testing chambers; rats move freely and lever-press.

food_restriction.evidence: Body weights were maintained at 320-350 g by limiting food to 15 g/day which included the food received during operant sessions.

time_to_assay.evidence: DOM, 4-OH-MiPT, and 5-MeO-DBT were tested following a 30-min pretreatment, whereas 5-Cl-DMT was tested with a 15-min pretreatment.

sample_size.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats (n = 16) ... Each compound was tested in groups of six rats.

outcomes.summary: 4-OH-MiPT (ED50=0.77 mg/kg) fully substituted for the DOM (0.5 mg/kg) discriminative stimulus, whereas 5-Cl-DMT (max 26-35% DOM-lever responding) and 5-MeO-DBT (max 39%) only partially substituted. DOM and 4-OH-MiPT did not alter response rate; 5-Cl-DMT (5 mg/kg) and 5-MeO-DBT (50 mg/kg) significantly suppressed responding.
outcomes.statistics: 5-Cl-DMT response rate F(4,20)=6.53, p=0.002; 5-MeO-DBT response rate F(5,25)=17.88, p<0.001. DOM ED50=0.23 mg/kg; 4-OH-MiPT ED50=0.77 mg/kg.
outcomes.evidence: DOM (ED 50 = 0.23 mg/kg) and 4-OH-MiPT (ED 50 = 0.77 mg/kg) fully substituted ... whereas 5-Cl-DMT and 5-MeO-DBT did not ... 5-Cl-DMT decreased responding following 5 mg/kg F(4, 20) = 6.53, p = 0.002 and 5-MeO-DBT suppressed responding following 50 mg/kg F(5, 25) = 17.88, p < 0.001.

judge_notes: Two distinct assays in this paper: (1) mouse locomotor activity (Digiscan, 8 h) and (2) rat DOM drug-discrimination operant task. GLM only reported the locomotor assay; qwen and gptoss reported both — retained both.
B1 for locomotor: only horizontal ambulation counts reported as a behavioural variable (score 0 = 1 measure). GLM mis-scored B1 as 1 with value '1'; corrected to score 0.

D1 for locomotor: a single uninterrupted 8 h session per animal = single session of long duration (D2=3, D6=1) but D1 is 'Single session' (0), not 'Continuous monitoring' (continuous monitoring per rubric implies repeated/ongoing home-cage-style recording).
Food restriction in the discrimination assay scored 'before' — rats were maintained at 320-350 g via 15 g/day food restriction, consistent with operant food-reinforcement protocols.
Setup habituation for discrimination scored 'yes' — ~60 training sessions in the operant chamber prior to substitution testing.

DOM is included as a study drug because it was administered behaviorally (training drug) and dose-response in locomotor activity, even though it is not one of the three 'novel tryptamines' framed in the title.

Housing: mice were group-housed, rats individually housed — group_housing scored 'yes' based on the mouse subjects (the majority and primary experimental cohort); the rat single-housing is noted in evidence.
